description: Repo-scale (docker-multiservice): a new container HEALTHCHECK needs a matching nginx location so it's reachable through the reverse proxy
prompts: Add a `HEALTHCHECK` instruction to api/Dockerfile: every 30s, timeout 3s, running `curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1`. This only covers checks issued from inside the container - add a matching `location /health` block to nginx/nginx.conf, proxying to `http://api:8000/health`, so external health probes hitting nginx (the only public entrypoint) can also reach it, alongside the existing catch-all `location /` block.

test_setup_files.check_healthcheck_wiring.py:
import re
from pathlib import Path

api_dockerfile = Path('api/Dockerfile').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
nginx_conf = Path('nginx/nginx.conf').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

assert re.search(r'HEALTHCHECK\b.*CMD.*curl.*http://localhost:8000/health', api_dockerfile), (
    'api/Dockerfile is missing a HEALTHCHECK that curls /health')

health_location = re.search(
    r'location\s+/health\s*\{[^}]*proxy_pass\s+http://api:8000/health', nginx_conf, re.DOTALL)
assert health_location, (
    "nginx.conf is missing a '/health' location proxying to the api service - the "
    'container has an internal HEALTHCHECK now, but nothing routes external health probes '
    'through the reverse proxy to reach it')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.api/Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

RUN useradd --create-home appuser
USER appuser

EXPOSE 8000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1

CMD ["python", "main.py"]
